name: Gilbert dis Balstein
original_name: ギルバルト・ディス・バルシュタイン
source: After the King was bedridden due to an illness, Gilbert became the regent for Princess [url=/c531]Licia[/url], who is too young to govern. Manipulative and cunning, Gilbert uses the impressionable Licia as his pawn to rule the kingdom, and [url=/c43511]Gau[/url] the "Mad Dog" to silence his enemies and anyone who seek out the secrets of the city.
